outcome: caesarean section due to cephalopelvic disproportion (CPD)
cohort: The study analyzed records of 1950 women who underwent caesarean section at Sakubva district hospital in 2021, comprising 348 cases due to CPD and 1602 cases with no CPD.
finding: The overall prevalence of caesarean section due to CPD was 18%, with significant risk factors identified including maternal age <=18 years, primigravida, gestational age >=40 weeks, being unreferred, rural residence, <4 ANC visits, and maternal height <=150 cm.
mod_finding: The study identified several maternal and obstetric factors significantly associated with an increased likelihood of caesarean section due to cephalopelvic disproportion.
